hadith:
Medicine - Narrated by 'Ursa -  Volume 7, Book 71, Number 593 

Aisha used to recommend At-Talbina for the sick and for such a person as grieved over a dead person. She used to say, "I heard Allah's Apostle saying, 'At-Talbina gives rest to the heart of the patient and makes it active and relieves some of his sorrow and grief.' "
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Mudhil - المُذِلُّ - The Humiliator

Al Mudhil refers to Allah's attribute of causing disgrace or humiliation to those who oppose His commands or reject His guidance. This name emphasizes the power of Allah to elevate or debase individuals based on their actions and faith. It serves as a reminder of the consequences of turning away from righteousness and the importance of adhering to divine guidance.
verse:
Al-Mursalat - The Emissaries - 77:44

Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.
